result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 3, Art. 8) covering the Transient Transportation Tax on vehicle rental operators, including registration, remittance, penalties, appeals, records, refunds, and enforcement provisions, mislabeled under a page about algorithmic rent price-fixing.
result.notes: This part contains only administrative provisions of the Transient Transportation Tax ordinance (vehicle rental business registration, tax remittance, penalties, appeals, records, refunds, liens, and criminal penalties). None concern residential rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The algorithmic-device prohibition text (SDMC § 98.1103 per the source URL) does not appear in this part, so no rules are extracted.
